name: Natori
source:
A Wolf that floats and speaks for who-knows-what reason.
He calls himself 'Someone who grants Wishes'.
He seems to love Ice-cream.

"Who are you calling a Dog, I'm a proudful Wolf."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.lumpofsugar.co.jp/product/yumahorome/#modal5]official website[/url]]
